ValidationRule.description: Before an opportunity can be put in "admission scheduled", must select either private pay or has insurance.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(RecordType.DeveloperName='Treatment_Opportunity', AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Admission Scheduled"), Private_Pay__c=false , Has_Insurance__c =false) ,false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select private pay or has insurance.
